scope: Offline conversion of the pinned extracted ACappellaSet v1.0 release to historical SK/AB inputs
checks: All released audio verified against pinned file hashes, sizes, headers, alignment and finite samples
All 749 prepared files independently checked; all padding decoded as exact silence
Released mixtures and stem bytes preserved; no normalization or recomputation
PC01 retained in layout but excluded from the 25-pair historical AB target manifest
No original scientific manifest rows, enrollment rules, model code, or source audio changed
Actual local CLI executed against the complete release, without authentication or network downloads
limits: JaCappella is separate and was not supplied or reconverted by this release adapter.
The loader smoke check reads one sample per conditioning mode from the full 13357-row training manifest; it is not a new training/convergence experiment.
Historical source hashes are checked where retained; generated silence matches absent-role samples, not historical WAV container bytes.
Relative symlinks require the source release to remain available at the same relative location; copy mode is self-contained.
Adapter requires the pinned release metadata and both extracted audio archives; custom metadata is not silently accepted.
